descriptionFull: Swainson's thrush ( Catharus ustulatus ), also called olive-backed thrush , is a medium-sized thrush. It is a member of Catharus genus and is typical of it in terms of its subdued coloration and beautiful voice. Swainson's thrush was named after William Swainson, an English ornithologist.
